input.quote: If not specified, Materials will be considered Type II Materials.
input.rationale: Deliverables default to Type II Materials, i.e. IBM (or third parties) own everything created for us unless it is expressly designated otherwise, and the licence back is limited to use within our Enterprise with no right to modify or sublicense; there is also no statement that we retain ownership of Content and our data. Redline flips the default to Type I and adds a Customer data ownership sentence.

input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant is expressly revocable, runs to Customer only (no Affiliates or contractors acting on our behalf), and 14.17 confirms no other rights are granted or transferable. Redline deletes revocability, extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors and makes it transferable to a successor.

input.quote: IBM reserves the right to investigate potential violations of the representations and warranties in Subsection 11.2(b). If IBM reasonably determines that a breach of any such warranty has occurred, then IBM may, in its sole and reasonable discretion:
input.rationale: IBM's investigation right is unlimited in frequency, requires no advance notice (only an attempt to notify after the fact before restricting access or removing Content), allocates no cost and does not exclude access to our systems. Redline inserts the standard once-per-12-months / 30-days' notice / IBM-cost / no-system-access limits.

input.quote: paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments
input.rationale: The only Customer-payable penalty-type amounts are the uncapped early termination charges (plus unspecified late payment fees in 4.2); Section 10 also preserves IBM's recovery of charges for Services "that would have been rendered but for Customer's breach". Redline confirms the capped early termination charge is the sole such amount payable by us.
